row.title: parked/ PRs had no SLA clock (PARKED-PR-1)
row.body: The branch reaper parks sessions as parked/<name> and completion_sweep opened automerge PRs for them; neither sweeper CLIENT_PREFIX nor sla BOT_PREFIX covered parked/, so 17 PRs aged past 8 h and agewatch failed the fleet job every pass. Both prefixes now include parked/, and the sweep skips parked/ and already-closed tips.
